response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS film_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(film_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts), above AS (SELECT rc.film_count, o.avg_count FROM rating_counts rc CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rc.film_count > o.avg_count) SELECT AVG(film_count) AS avg_count_above, AVG(film_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM above

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-rating distinct-film counts across all ratings that have at least one rental (all 5 ratings are expected to appear).
Only films with at least one rental are counted; rentals link to films solely via inventory.
Ratings with count strictly above the average are included (ties excluded).
